claim: McpRuntime.make rejects a protocol list with more than one Stateless adapter at Layer construction with Cause.IllegalArgumentError("MCP runtime supports at most one stateless protocol").
McpProtocol.v2026_07_28 is the only shipped StatelessRuntimeDescriptor; its transport policy is jsonRpc.acceptsBatches=false and http={}.

On HTTP, a request is classified stateless if params._meta carries io.modelcontextprotocol/protocolVersion, or if a stateless adapter is configured and (the request is not initialize or there is no stateful runtime) and (MCP-Protocol-Version matches the stateless version or there is no stateful runtime and the body is a JSON-RPC request with an id).
A v2026-only HTTP server classifies every JSON-RPC request including initialize as stateless because stateful is undefined.
Stateless HTTP admission requires MCP-Protocol-Version; missing it is HTTP 400 JSON-RPC HEADER_MISMATCH_ERROR_CODE (-32020) with message "MCP-Protocol-Version header is required".
Stateless HTTP admission without params._meta (except notifications/cancelled) is HTTP 400 JSON-RPC INVALID_PARAMS_ERROR_CODE (-32602) "Required request metadata is missing".
Mcp-Method must equal JSON-RPC method and, for tools/call and prompts/get, Mcp-Name must equal params.name (resources/read uses params.uri); mismatch is HTTP 400 HEADER_MISMATCH_ERROR_CODE (-32020).
Unsupported MCP-Protocol-Version on the stateless path is HTTP 400 JSON-RPC -32022 "Unsupported protocol version '<header>'" with data {supported, requested}.

A v2026-only HTTP server answers initialize that carries 2026 headers and _meta with HTTP 404 JSON-RPC METHOD_NOT_FOUND_ERROR_CODE (-32601) "Method not found: initialize" because initialize is not in ClientRequestRpcs/handlerRpcs.
A v2026-only HTTP server answers a bare legacy initialize (no version header/_meta) with HTTP 400 HEADER_MISMATCH_ERROR_CODE (-32020), not method-not-found.

On stdio, initialize without protocol-version _meta on a v2026-only server fails in prepareRequest with ProtocolError -32022 "initialize is not supported by the configured MCP protocols (requested '<offeredVersion>')". No dedicated stdio test name was found.

G4 (v2026_07_28 only, no mixed lists) is implementable. Mixed lists are allowed by the runtime (at most one stateless) and keep initialize alive: initialize offering protocolVersion 2026-07-28 still negotiates the first stateful adapter and mints Mcp-Session-Id.
v2026_07_28 jsonRpc.acceptsBatches is false; HTTP batches are admitHttp 400; stdio batches become invalid/json-rpc-batch encoded as -32600 "JSON-RPC batches are not supported".

server/discover payload is {_meta: RequestMetaObject}; DiscoverResult is resultType complete, ttlMs 0, cacheScope private, supportedVersions from configured adapters, optional instructions, and capabilities starting as {completions:{}, logging:{}}.

Discover capabilities.tools/resources/prompts are omitted unless those registrations exist; listChanged and resources.subscribe equal supportsSubscriptions (sendNotification !== undefined). Object-valued extensions are copied; scalar/array/null extension settings are dropped.

instructions is a top-level optional DiscoverResult field. description, websiteUrl, and icons are not top-level discover fields; they live on Implementation inside _meta["io.modelcontextprotocol/serverInfo"].
layerStdio uses newline-delimited JSON-RPC (RpcSerialization.ndjson + JSON-RPC parser). Content-Length framing is not implemented.
Stdio reconstructs UTF-8 JSON-RPC records split across chunks via TextDecoder stream:true remainder buffer; stdin close interrupts the stdio protocol fiber. clientIds is the constant Set([0]).

layerHttp is single-endpoint POST Streamable HTTP. GET/PUT/PATCH/DELETE/OPTIONS return 405 Allow:POST (or 403 if Origin fails). GET SSE is not offered. Content-Type must be application/json (else 415); Accept must include both application/json and text/event-stream (else 406).
Default allowedOrigins is undefined treated as []. Any Origin header is HTTP 403; Origin-less clients are allowed. Exact string match.
Accepted HTTP notifications and JSON-RPC response POSTs return empty 202. subscriptions/listen and multi-message/stream bodies are converted to text/event-stream SSE frames.
On a v2026-only HTTP server, Mcp-Session-Id is not read or set on the stateless path; a caller-supplied session id is ignored and the response has no Mcp-Session-Id.

McpRequestContext fields are clientId, protocolVersion, clientCapabilities, optional clientInfo, requestMetadata, optional inputResponses, optional requestState. Stateless prepareRequest populates the first five from decoded _meta plus the transport clientId; inputResponses/requestState are overlaid later from the RPC payload.
Stdio clientId is always 0 for the process. HTTP clientId is clientId++ per POST and is disconnected when that request scope ends. clientId is not stable across HTTP requests from one client.

No McpRequestContext field is server-minted and stable across HTTP requests. 2026 does not mint Mcp-Session-Id; requestState is a client-echoed opaque string; subscriptionId is the client's JSON-RPC request id.

Handlers return McpSchema.InputRequired; the 2026 wire form is InputRequiredResult with resultType input_required. Input kinds are sampling/createMessage, roots/list, and elicitation/create (form or url). The server holds no continuation store; the client retries the same method with inputResponses and/or requestState.

Returning input_required when the client omitted required capabilities is HTTP 400 JSON-RPC -32021 MISSING_REQUIRED_CLIENT_CAPABILITY. Empty elicitation {} counts as form support. resources/read schema allows InputRequiredResult but the 2026 handler never returns it.
2026 ServerRequestRpcs is empty; toReverseClient always fails with McpReverseOperationUnsupported reason "MCP 2026-07-28 carries server input requests in multi round-trip results".

subscriptions/listen honors the intersection of the requested SubscriptionFilter and registrationPresence (tools/prompts/resources listChanged and resource URI set). If sendNotification is undefined it fails METHOD_NOT_FOUND (-32601) "Method not found: subscriptions/listen". Pending overflow limit is 64.

layerStdio and layerHttp both set supportsNotifications true, so sendNotification is installed and subscriptions/listen works; the method-not-found path is a custom RpcServer.Protocol with supportsNotifications false. Logging/progress are not delivered on the listen stream.
2026 CallToolResult.structuredContent is optional JSON (non-object values allowed). Toolkit success copies encodedResult into structuredContent; older revisions omit non-object structuredContent.

tools/call maps ToolExecutionError and InvalidToolInput to CallToolResult isError true (result, not JSON-RPC error). ToolNotFound and InvalidToolContinuation become JSON-RPC -32602. Strict tools decode with onExcessProperty error; strict raw JSON Schema tools die at registration.

Declared Toolkit handler failures become CallToolResult isError true without structuredContent. Defects and undeclared errors are logged/reported and returned as isError with generic text "Tool execution failed due to an internal server error." RPC non-Fail defects become InternalError "Internal error".

logging/setLevel, ping, initialize, resources/subscribe, resources/unsubscribe, and tasks/* are absent from the 2026 adapter and return HTTP 404 method-not-found. logging and completions capabilities are still always advertised as empty objects. PingRpcs is installed only for stateful protocols.

HTTP notifications/cancelled on a 2026-only server is 202-acked but does not interrupt another POST's in-flight request because McpServer returns immediately when session is undefined. Active-request interrupt is proven on stdio (clientId 0) only.

prompts/list returns HTTP 404 METHOD_NOT_FOUND when no prompts are registered; tools/list and resources/list handlers do not 404 on empty registries. Pagination cursor is on the 2026 list payloads but the adapter never reads it.
Unknown 2026 HTTP methods including client notifications/progress are admitHttp 404 Method not found. Unknown stdio notifications (isNotification) are dropped with no response.
In-repo HTTP launchers that do not pass allowedOrigins will 403 any browser Origin. In-repo clients that still send initialize or ping will fail against a v2026-only server (G6 in-scope).

JSON-RPC error code constants used by this runtime: PARSE -32700, INVALID_REQUEST -32600, METHOD_NOT_FOUND -32601, INVALID_PARAMS -32602, INTERNAL -32603, HEADER_MISMATCH -32020, MISSING_REQUIRED_CLIENT_CAPABILITY -32021, UNSUPPORTED_PROTOCOL_VERSION -32022.

The 2026 handler set is server/discover, resources/list, resources/templates/list, resources/read, prompts/list, prompts/get, completion/complete, tools/list, tools/call, subscriptions/listen, notifications/cancelled.
